name: @hasna/slides
description: Headless presentation-deck SDK for Hasna-coded apps — author slides in Markdown or HTML, model themes/transitions/fragments/vertical stacks, serialize to JSON, and export a self-contained reveal.js HTML deck. Ships a React reveal.js viewer at @hasna/slides/react.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:lib && bun run build:dashboard
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun && bun run build:react && bun run build:types
scripts.build:react: NODE_ENV=production bun build src/react/index.tsx --outdir dist/react --target bun --external react --external react-dom --external reveal.js --external "reveal.js/*"
scripts.prepack: bun run build:lib && bun run scan:artifact
scripts.postinstall: if test -f dashboard/package.json; then cd dashboard && bun install --frozen-lockfile; fi

author: hasna
